text:
incident-bot: INCIDENT PAGER: Severity P2 — sustained error surge on dedicated-west pool (autoscale pressure). Paging oncall @maria. Metrics: 5xx rate +120%, queue depth +8x, tail latency >3s. Triggered at 2026-02-18T18:05:33Z

maria: on it — looking at dashboards now. can whoever's on infra share the autoscaler logs?

sam: i'm on the pool side. quick summary: dedicated-west hit max_reserved_nodes for several groups, autoscaler attempted adds but rejected. GPU util 96% across current nodes. burst capacity flag appears off.

maria: ok that explains it. customers seeing 429s or timeouts?

josh: saw several customers reporting 429s from our API gateway (upstream response from dedicated service). examples: AcmeCorp (heavy batch inference), BetaApps (realtime).

tara: can we flip burst capacity to allow extra nodes while we investigate? that's our fastest mitigation. also we can apply short-term per-tenant rate limits to reduce pressure.

sam: yes, we have two options: 1) enable burst capacity for dedicated-west (adds up to 2 burst nodes immediately) or 2) temporarily raise max_reserved_nodes. enabling burst is faster and doesn't require billing changes.

maria: do the burst toggle and put a small ramp rate in place so we don't overshoot. josh will monitor. tara pls prepare a rate-limit rule if burst doesn't stabilize in 5m.

sam: running command now:
```
# enable burst nodes (internal controller)
redwoodctl pools update dedicated-west --burst-capacity enable --burst-nodes 2
# verify new nodes requested
redwoodctl pools describe dedicated-west --watch
```

sam: command accepted by controller, provisioning started. kube events show new node requests to cloud provider. ETA ~90s per instance.

maria: nice. applying a soft per-tenant throttle to protect small customers:
```
# apply traffic shaping rule for dedicated-west ingress
traffic-shaper set --pool dedicated-west --rule "per-tenant:default=20r/s,heavy=10r/s" --expires 10m --reason "auto-mitigate surge"
```

kyle: heads-up: that rule will translate to a 429 for high-volume tenants after burst capacity is exhausted. we should message key customers.

josh: metrics: tail latency dropping slightly, 5xx rate trending down. new nodes still joining. queue depth halved in last 45s.

maria: good. tara — please draft short customer note for AcmeCorp + BetaApps (internal channel) and flag support. keep them in the loop about temporary throttling.

sam: new nodes are online. autoscaler now showing available headroom. I'm also bumping the node max cap by +1 as safety: 
```
redwoodctl pools update dedicated-west --max-reserved-nodes 12
```

maria: leaving command window open for 10m to watch for regressions. if errors creep back, we'll revert rate-limits and start targeted fallbacks (model-variant downgrade for heavy customers).

josh: seeing reduction: 5xx down to normal for most tenants, AcmeCorp still has a couple of 429s but throughput restored.

incident-bot: NOTE: runbook reference — "Dedicated pool burst + quota mitigation" applied. Incident ID: INC-2026-0487.

tara: handoff to post-incident: i'll own the mitigation follow-up doc and action items. need owner for root cause investigation into why autoscaler didn't provision earlier (policy race?). sam, can you own that?

sam: yep, i'll take RC investigation. first pass: look at controller logs around 18:03-18:06, check cloud provider quota limits, and cloud API retry behavior.

maria: prepping a short incident summary for execs: initial cause = traffic surge + pool at max_reserved_nodes, mitigation = enabled burst nodes + temporary per-tenant rate limits + increased max_reserved_nodes. impact = P2, limited 429s for 2 enterprise customers for ~4 minutes, no data loss.

josh: adding monitoring TODO: add a synthetic that simulates per-tenant large-batch spike so autoscaler policies get exercised in CI.

kyle: also let's add alert rule: if autoscaler attempts >3 scale events in 2m AND pool at max_reserved_nodes => fire pager to eng-platform before customer-facing errors.

maria: agreed. ok wrapping up — i'll close the pager once support confirms customer messages sent. thanks all. :thumbsup:

tara: creating follow-up ticket INC-2026-0487 in ops board with actions: (1) RC by sam, (2) add autoscaler preflight check by platform, (3) postmortem + customer comms review. tagging @support for outreach.

maria: handoff: i'm going offline for dinner in ~20m; tara will be lead for the follow-ups. josh remain on-watch for 30m.

josh: ack. monitoring window started.

incident-bot: INCIDENT STATUS: mitigated -> monitoring. closing pager in 30m unless regression.
